# 🥊 THE NEW CLUB FIGHT EXPERIENCE IS HERE! 🔥

[media]

**The Club has changed.**

Club Fight is now a **solo combat** experience where you **face powerful bosses**, **master different weapons**, and **fight your way** through a series of increasingly difficult locations. 👊


# 💥 FOUR FIGHTS. FOUR BOSSES. ONE FINAL CHALLENGE.

[media]

**🥊 TITAN — THE CLUB**

Start your journey against the Titan, a **massive powerhouse** who brings **brute strength** and **heavy hits** to the dance floor. 

**🐱 CATGIRL — THE ROOFTOP**

Take the fight outside and up to the Rooftop, where Catgirl awaits. **Faster**, **more unpredictable**, and **ready to test your reactions**, she’ll push you to fight smarter and stay on your toes.

**🔨 BLACKSMITH — THE FORGE** 

Things get serious at the Forge. Face the **imposing Blacksmith**, armed with his **massive hammer** and built for **close-range destruction.** 

**🧪 CHEMIST — THE LAB — COMING SOON**
The final challenge is waiting in the Lab. The Chemist is preparing something dangerous, and this fight will push your skills even further. **Coming soon.**

[media]

# 🥋 TRAIN BEFORE YOU FIGHT

Need to sharpen your skills? **Step into the Dojo** and test different weapons in a risk-free environment. Practice your aim, experiment with your arsenal, and prepare for your next boss.

# 🔥 CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTER

**Pick your fighter skin**, choose your weapons, and step into the Club your way. 

The new Club is open. The bosses are waiting. **Are you ready to fight your way to the end? 💀**

💬 Join the community and share your progress: **https://discord.com/invite/etermaxrstudio**
